questionText:

A comprehensive psychological assessment reveals an IQ of 138 on the Wechsler Intelligence Scale, but significantly below-average scores on emotional intelligence measures. Shabnam has always stood first in her class. She enjoys all the subjects in
the curriculum. Soon, she has to choose her stream, but she is still not
sure if she should opt for Science or Humanities. Which psychological test
could guide her in choosing the appropriate stream?

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Psychological Testing: Aptitude vs Achievement and Interest.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Variations in Psychological Attributes (Psychological Testing: Aptitude vs Achievement and Interest):
Aptitude test

Detailed Analysis:
Because Shabnam excels across all current school subjects, achievement tests cannot differentiate her future potential. A standardized multiple aptitude test (e.g. DBDA, DAT) will measure specific cognitive strengths to guide stream selection.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

questionText: Which of the following statements regarding Calculation of Intelligence Quotient (IQ) in Variations in Psychological Attributes is INCORRECT / NOT true?

options.text: It conforms strictly to the standard equilibrium conditions defined in NCERT Variations in Psychological Attributes.

options.text: Its magnitude depends directly on the governing physical or analytical constants of Calculation of Intelligence Quotient (IQ).

questionText: In the normal probability distribution of IQ scores (mean = 100, SD = 15), what percentage of cases falls within ±1 and ±2 standard deviations respectively?

options.text: Approximately 68.26% of cases fall between ±1 standard deviation (IQ 85 to 115), and 95.44% fall between ±2 standard deviations (IQ 70 to 130)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Assessment of Intelligence.

options.text: Only 10% of cases fall within two standard deviations of the mean
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: 100% of cases fall between IQ 99 and 101 with zero dispersion
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: 50% of cases fall above IQ 130 and 50% fall below IQ 70
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Assessment of Intelligence (Variations in Psychological Attributes):
In a normal bell curve with mean = 100 and SD = 15: approximately 68% of the population falls between IQ 85 and 115 (±1 SD), and approximately 95% falls between IQ 70 and 130 (±2 SD).
Hence, Option C is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
